github-accelerator v1.2.0 introduces a fallback solution for unreliable GitHub access by scripting direct and mirror access for git operations.

- Adds `gh_accel.sh`, a self-contained Bash script for checking, downloading, and cloning via direct or mirror routes
- Supports seamless fallback to mirrors for repo clone and file downloads when direct GitHub access fails
- Includes a real-time connectivity check and prioritizes mirrors by health
- Integrates local/private mirror configuration for advanced use
- Documents scenario coverage, workflow, troubleshooting, and best practices for safe and effective use
